#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

int countSmaller(const vector<int>& arr, int startIdx, int val) {
    int count = 0;
    for (int i = startIdx; i < arr.size() && arr[i] < val; i++) {
        count++;
    }
    return count;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int total;
    cin >> total;
    string sequence;
    cin >> sequence;

    vector<int> vPositions, kPositions, xPositions;
    for (int i = 0; i < total; i++) {
        char ch = sequence[i];
        if (ch == 'V') vPositions.push_back(i);
        else if (ch == 'K') kPositions.push_back(i);
        else xPositions.push_back(i);
    }

    int vCount = vPositions.size();
    int kCount = kPositions.size();
    int xCount = xPositions.size();

    // Initialize 4D DP array with large values
    vector<vector<vector<vector<long long>>>> dpTable(
        vCount + 1,
        vector<vector<vector<long long>>>(
            kCount + 1,
            vector<vector<long long>>(
                xCount + 1,
                vector<long long>(2, LLONG_MAX)
            )
        )
    );

    dpTable[0][0][0][0] = 0;

    for (int vIdx = 0; vIdx <= vCount; vIdx++) {
        for (int kIdx = 0; kIdx <= kCount; kIdx++) {
            for (int xIdx = 0; xIdx <= xCount; xIdx++) {
                for (int t = 0; t < 2; t++) {
                    long long currentCost = dpTable[vIdx][kIdx][xIdx][t];
                    if (currentCost == LLONG_MAX) continue;

                    // Choose next V
                    if (vIdx < vCount) {
                        int posV = vPositions[vIdx];
                        int moves = countSmaller(vPositions, vIdx, posV)
                                    + countSmaller(kPositions, kIdx, posV)
                                    + countSmaller(xPositions, xIdx, posV);
                        long long newCost = currentCost + moves;
                        if (dpTable[vIdx + 1][kIdx][xIdx][1] > newCost) {
                            dpTable[vIdx + 1][kIdx][xIdx][1] = newCost;
                        }
                    }

                    // Choose next K (only if t == 0)
                    if (kIdx < kCount && t == 0) {
                        int posK = kPositions[kIdx];
                        int moves = countSmaller(vPositions, vIdx, posK)
                                    + countSmaller(kPositions, kIdx, posK)
                                    + countSmaller(xPositions, xIdx, posK);
                        long long newCost = currentCost + moves;
                        if (dpTable[vIdx][kIdx + 1][xIdx][0] > newCost) {
                            dpTable[vIdx][kIdx + 1][xIdx][0] = newCost;
                        }
                    }

                    // Choose next X
                    if (xIdx < xCount) {
                        int posX = xPositions[xIdx];
                        int moves = countSmaller(vPositions, vIdx, posX)
                                    + countSmaller(kPositions, kIdx, posX)
                                    + countSmaller(xPositions, xIdx, posX);
                        long long newCost = currentCost + moves;
                        if (dpTable[vIdx][kIdx][xIdx + 1][0] > newCost) {
                            dpTable[vIdx][kIdx][xIdx + 1][0] = newCost;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    long long minTotalCost = LLONG_MAX;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        if (dpTable[vCount][kCount][xCount][i] < minTotalCost) {
            minTotalCost = dpTable[vCount][kCount][xCount][i];
        }
    }

    cout << minTotalCost << "\n";

    return 0;
}
